item.title: suddeny very slow
item.body:
Type: Bug I was making great progress with a project and suddenly copilot is very slow. Its was in the "working" status overnight. This morning I stopped and started the conversation mulitple times. Restarted vscode insiders, and even tried another model and no progress. I am going to restart my Pc too. The work it was doing was no harder than the ones it had been very quick and responsive about yesterday. Possibly I used a lot a of credits - but there is no message saying that. Very frustrating.
